query: WITH client_stats AS (SELECT c.id, c.nome, COUNT(v.id) AS numero_vendite, SUM(v.importo) AS totale_speso, AVG(v.importo) AS media_spesa, MAX(v.importo) AS max_spesa, MIN(v.importo) AS min_spesa, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.importo > 100) AS vendite_alte, SUM(CASE WHEN v.importo > 100 THEN v.importo ELSE 0 END) AS totale_vendite_alte FROM clienti c JOIN vendite v ON c.id = v.cliente_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome HAVING SUM(v.importo) >= 50), client_comparison AS (SELECT cs1.nome AS cliente_principale, cs1.totale_speso AS spesa_principale, cs2.nome AS cliente_confronto, cs2.totale_speso AS spesa_confronto FROM client_stats cs1 JOIN client_stats cs2 ON cs1.id != cs2.id), high_spenders AS (SELECT id, nome, totale_speso FROM client_stats WHERE totale_speso > 200 UNION SELECT id, nome, totale_speso FROM client_stats WHERE vendite_alte >= 2), inactive_clients AS (SELECT c.id, c.nome FROM clienti c LEFT JOIN vendite v ON c.id = v.cliente_id WHERE v.cliente_id IS NULL) SELECT cs.nome, cs.numero_vendite, cs.totale_speso, cs.media_spesa, cs.max_spesa, cs.min_spesa, cs.vendite_alte, cs.totale_vendite_alte, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.totale_speso DESC) AS posizione, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.totale_speso DESC) AS rank_spesa, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.numero_vendite DESC) AS rank_vendite, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clienti) AS totale_clienti, (SELECT SUM(importo) FROM vendite) AS totale_fatturato, (SELECT AVG(importo) FROM vendite WHERE importo > 100) AS media_vendite_alte, (SELECT MAX(v2.importo) FROM vendite v2 WHERE v2.cliente_id = cs.id) AS max_vendita_cliente, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_spenders hs WHERE hs.id = cs.id) AS flag_high_spender, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_comparison cc WHERE cc.cliente_principale = cs.nome) AS comparazioni_clienti FROM client_stats cs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inactive_clients ic WHERE ic.id = cs.id) ORDER BY cs.totale_speso DESC LIMIT 10;
